plan.title: AQ-OS Requirements — honest program-level completion (owner review required)
plan.goal: The program-level requirement map: every Foundation/Product/Track/cross-cutting requirement the owner wants, on the honest tier scale. FIRST CUT assembled from the unified plan + 43 PRDs — OWNER MUST REVIEW/CORRECT; the orchestrator does not decide what is 'done'.
success_criteria: Every major requirement area accounted for, honestly marked (most are unmeasured/not-started)
Nothing reads complete without VALIDATED + owner acceptance
The gap between '43 PRDs' and '5 tracked' is made visible, not hidden
plan.tier_model: DEFINED=PRD/plan exists (designed); INTEGRATED=implemented + wired; VALIDATED=works end-to-end; ACCEPTED=owner signed off. detection.freeze_record = the PRD (existence proves DESIGNED, not done). MANY items are NOT-STARTED/unmeasured — that is the honest state.
plan.honest_note: 43 PRD docs exist; only 5 program areas have projected trackers. This board is a FIRST CUT for owner correction — add missing requirements, fix any status the owner disputes. Percentages here count INTEGRATION toward the tier, never owner-accepted completion (all acceptance=pending).
